newsitem.title: USA: Coleman to issue notes, redeem others.
newsitem.headline: Coleman to issue notes, redeem others.

text.p: Coleman Holdings Inc and Coleman Worldwide Corp said in a joint statement Monday that a newly formed parent holding company will issue senior secured discount notes due 2001, raising about $455.3 million, and set the terms for the repurchase of notes.
The deal is scheduled to close on May 20, 1997.

Proceeds will be used to redeem Coleman Holdings's senior secured discount notes due 1998, and to retire Coleman Worldwide's liquid yield option notes due 2013, said the companies, which are controlled by Ronald Perelman's McAndrews & Forbes.

Upon redemption of the Coleman Holdings notes and retirement of the liquid yield option notes, the parent's notes will be secured by the 83 percent stake in Coleman Co common stock owned by Coleman Worldwide.
Coleman Worldwide will commence an offer later this week to exchange the liquid yield option notes for cash at $343.61 per $1,000 principal amount at maturity, the companies said.
Each liquid yield option note is currently exchangeable into Coleman common stock having a value of $263.08 per $1,000 principal amount at maturity, based on the May 16 closing share price,
Any liquid yield option notes remaining outstanding on May 27, 1998, will be redeemed by Coleman Worldwide at their redemption price of $343.61 per $1,000 principal amount at maturity.
